response.overview: Rafique is still single and lives with his grandmother in the village. Rafique runs a small car repair workshop in his village. Maisara, now 19 years old, is continuing her studies at a local university. The grandmother, feeling lonely with an empty nest, takes on work caring for 4 neighborhood children whose parents both work. Of the 4 children cared for by the grandmother, one of them named Sadique has a "copy paste" habit or behavior just like Rafique's behavior when he was young – mischievous in a quiet way and often a victim of circumstances. Ramadan has come again, and Rafique sees Sadique's attitude is the same as his when he was young. Rafique tries to use his "DIARY FROM WHEN HE WAS YOUNG" as a reference source, but he is mistaken – times have changed, and children's mischief in this era is no longer like it was in his time. The drama cast of Rafique's Ramadan Diary Reunion
response.title: Diari Ramadan Rafique Reunion
